environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes with pod security context specifying readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. The container image uses a distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12). No emptyDir, hostPath, or PVC volumes are mounted. The pod spec does not include any volumeMounts with writable backing. The container's /tmp does not exist as a separate mount - it is part of the read-only overlay filesystem. The OCI runtime (runc) enforces the rootfs as ro at the mount namespace level. Additionally, the container runs with allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and drops ALL capabilities. The tool is compiled with the same flags and receives input identically via a sidecar proxy.

config.network: sidecar envoy proxy forwarding to stdin
